data.name: Barceló Guadalajara
data.address: Av de Las Rosas 2933, Rinconada del Bosque, 44530 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
In the World Trade Center business complex, this modern hotel is 7.6 km from the city center and 10 km from football matches at Jalisco Stadium.
Posh rooms have custom-designed beds, coffeemakers and desks, plus flat-screens and free Wi-Fi. Club rooms offer access to a lounge with free snacks and evening cocktails. Suites add separate living areas; upgraded 2-story suites include private gyms and meeting rooms.
Breakfast is free. There's a casual restaurant, a cafe and a wine bar, along with a gym, an outdoor pool, and a spa with a steam room and a solarium. Additional amenities include a business center and 36,000 sq ft of meeting space.
